visual_hierarchy.justification: The hero h1 and supporting h2 below it have clear size separation, but within the hero block the gold dot competes with the headline instead of reading as a quiet margin marker beside a lesson number.
visual_hierarchy.observation: Hero h1 sits at roughly 64px, supporting paragraph at ~18px (~3.5:1 ratio), but the gold dot is ~130px in diameter — larger than a single line of the h1 — so it dominates the right column at 1440px rather than acting as a 10px margin mark.

use_of_space.justification: The hero uses an approximate left 50% / right 50% split where the right column holds only a single oversized circle, leaving roughly 35-40% of the viewport as empty white at 1440px.
use_of_space.observation: At 1440x900, the right column (x≈900–1300) is ~400px wide and contains only the gold dot centered vertically against the headline — roughly 280,000px² of unused canvas with no secondary lesson number, margin note, or chapter cue.

typographic_contrast.justification: Sentence-case headings, mixed line lengths, and a restrained single-weight sans create a teacher-like workbook feel consistent with the confessional-educational register.
typographic_contrast.observation: Display h1 is approximately 64px / lh ~1.05, supporting h2 around 32px, body around 18px — a clean three-step scale with no italics, all-caps, or stretched display, matching the 'no impact tropes' rule.

focal_point.justification: The brief calls for the gold dot to read as a 10px margin marker beside lesson numbers; here it is rendered as a 130px decorative sun, which inverts the signature element and splits focus with the headline.
focal_point.observation: Gold circle diameter in the hero is roughly 13× the signature specification of 10px, and it is placed in negative space rather than adjacent to a lesson number or margin note — the focal point becomes the dot, not the lesson.

brand_fit.justification: The sentence-case, teacher-like headline ('All brands are unique…') fits the confessional-educational register, but the oversized dot contradicts the brand's own signature element spec and the right-side emptiness breaks the workbook framing.
brand_fit.observation: The brief explicitly states the dot must be a fixed 10px SVG travelling with lesson numbers; the rendered dot is a static ~130px circle, violating both size and behavior contracts of the signature element.

motion_restraint.justification: No pulsing, parallax, or animated flourishes are visible — the page reads as still, which honors the 'never animate opacity, never pulse' rule.
motion_restraint.observation: Across both viewports only the static layout is observable; there are no transition cues, hover hints, or animated underlines — restraint is intact even if the signature element itself is mis-scaled.

looks_templated.justification: The single h1 + sub + oversized accent-circle pattern is a recognizable 'agency hero' template, but the sentence-case teaching voice and the custom Pedicel brand framing keep it from reading as fully generic.
looks_templated.observation: The hero composition (left-aligned headline block, right-aligned single decorative shape, small section label '01 / 0025FBE0D' below) repeats a stock Webflow hero pattern that appears on hundreds of agency sites.

revisions.change: Shrink the gold circle from ~130px to the spec'd 10px and pin it to the left margin as a fixed-position marker immediately left of the headline baseline; remove the centered right-column placement.
revisions.rationale: The signature element is defined as a 10px margin marker beside lesson numbers — at 13× that size it stops being a highlighter and becomes a decorative sun, breaking the brand_fit and focal_point contracts.
revisions.addressed_observation: Gold circle diameter in the hero is roughly 13× the signature specification of 10px, and it is placed in negative space rather than adjacent to a lesson number or margin note — the focal point becomes the dot, not the lesson.

revisions.change: Replace the empty right half (x≈900–1300 at 1440px) with a vertical chapter index: a small '01' numeral followed by 4–5 sentence-case lesson titles in a tight column, with the 10px gold dot sitting to the left of the active item.
revisions.rationale: The thesis calls for a workbook where the dot marks every lesson being read; a chapter index in the right column turns dead canvas into the page's table of contents and gives the dot a structural job to do.
revisions.addressed_observation: At 1440x900, the right column (x≈900–1300) is ~400px wide and contains only the gold dot centered vertically against the headline — roughly 280,000px² of unused canvas with no secondary lesson number, margin note, or chapter cue.

revisions.change: Break the manifesto section out of the same white background by giving it a subtle alice-blue fill (#f0f6fa, pulled from the logo surface per palette_from_logo.rationale) and a single sentence-case subhead in the upper-left corner.
revisions.rationale: Right now the manifesto reads as a continuation of the hero — same background, same alignment, same shape. A background shift turns it into a visible chapter opening, which is what the 'quiet lesson' thesis depends on.
revisions.addressed_observation: The manifesto 'What we believe…' section sits directly under the hero on identical white with the same left-aligned h2/p shape, giving the page two consecutive identical sections and zero rhythm change.

revisions.change: Number each service item with a left-margin numeral ('01', '02', '03') and place the 10px gold dot flush-left of that numeral; left-justify the service title under the numeral rather than centering it.
revisions.rationale: The signature element is supposed to mark every lesson being read; without lesson numbers beside each service, the dot has nothing to travel between and the chapters don't read as chapters.
revisions.addressed_observation: Observed that no section in the rendered HTML is named with a numbered lesson prefix (no '01 /', '02 /' style structure visible on services-as-chapters), so the dot-as-highlighter mechanic has no anchor points.

revisions.change: Restructure the section as a two-column 'annotated image essay' at >=1024px: a left column holding a single bespoke marketing visual with three 10px gold dots placed in its margins, and a right column of sentence-case teacher-margin notes aligned to each dot.
revisions.rationale: The signature element description explicitly references 'the annotated image essay' with margin notes; the current layout has no annotated visual and no margin notes, so the signature element has nothing to highlight.
revisions.addressed_observation: The brief's signature element description names 'the annotated image essay' as one of the dot's three anchor contexts, but the-customised-proof renders as a plain text column with no image and no margin annotations.
